name: Dragon
description: An ancient scaled tyrant sitting on a mountain of coin.

powers.name: Fire Breath
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Burns terrain too.

powers.name: Crushing Dive
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is knocked prone.

tactics: Opens with Fire Breath on a group, then picks off stragglers from the air. Offers a deal if losing.

name: Owlbear
description: A shaggy, feathered bear-thing with a beak like a hatchet and a terrible temper.
tactics: Grabs one player and refuses to let go. Will chase anything that runs.

name: Chest Lurker
description: A fat wooden chest that is, regrettably, mostly teeth and glue.

powers.name: Sticky Gulp
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Anyone touching it is stuck until they win a Physique challenge.

tactics: Waits to be opened. Players that loot first get gulped first.

name: Jelly Block
description: A see-through wobbling cube that scours dungeon corridors clean, with bones and coins floating inside.
skillNote: Players have disadvantage to spot it.

powers.name: Swallow
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense, and the target is carried inside it until freed.

tactics: Slides down corridors and fills them. Loot is visible inside it.

name: Ore Muncher
description: A pink, armored bug-lizard with feathery antennae that adores iron.

powers.name: Rust Touch
powers.text: No damage. A metal weapon or armor it touches crumbles; that item no longer gives its bonus.

tactics: Ignores players and goes for the sword. Wooden and bone gear is safe.

name: Stone Gazer
description: A hissing woman with a head of living snakes whose eyes turn warriors into statues.

powers.name: Stone Gaze
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. A player dropped to 0 by it is turned to stone, not unconscious, until cured.

tactics: Hides in a statue garden. Players who look away or use a mirror roll to avoid the gaze.

name: Mountain Dinosaur
description: A spiked, horned, mountain-sized horror that sleeps for centuries and wakes up hungry.

powers.name: Earthshaking Charge
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Everything it runs through is flattened.

powers.name: Mirror Shell
powers.text: No damage. Reflects the first ray, bolt or beam that hits it back at whoever fired it.

tactics: Not a fight, a disaster. Players should run, plan, or find a way to put it back to sleep.

name: Pit Gorger
description: A bellowing, long-armed brute kept in a dungeon pit and fed anything that falls in.
tactics: Grabs a player and eats them next turn unless they get free with a Physique challenge.

name: Sand Maw
description: A tooth-ringed pit in the desert sand hiding a creature that takes a thousand years to digest a meal.

powers.name: Swallow
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is pulled in and stuck until freed.

tactics: Never moves. Anything that walks over the edge of the pit is dragged in.

name: Dune Wyrm
description: A cliff-sized horned desert serpent whose belly is full of pearls and bones.

powers.name: Burrow
powers.text: No damage. Disappears under the sand and may reappear anywhere within 3 pencil lengths.

tactics: Erupts from underneath. Retreats into the sand when badly hurt.

name: Slug Lord
description: A massive, slug-like crime boss who lounges on a dais surrounded by hired muscle.

powers.name: Hired Muscle
powers.text: No damage. Calls in two Chrome Troopers or Battle Clanks (0.25 difficulty each).

tactics: Never fights alone. Offers a deal, then reaches for the trapdoor lever.

name: Bouncy Slime
description: A cheerful, wobbling blob that bounces off the walls and likes to be hugged.
tactics: Splits into two 0.25-difficulty slimes when hit for 5 or more damage.

name: Puff Dragon
description: A cat-sized, sparkly dragon that sneezes small flames and curls up in your hat.

powers.name: Tiny Flame Belch
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Lights candles and snacks.

tactics: Plays at fighting. Bursts into tears if properly scolded.

name: Black Ooze Mass
description: A bubbling, hundred-eyed, house-sized slick of black protoplasm that cries 'tekeli-li' from a thousand mouths.

powers.name: Engulf
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is pulled inside until freed.

tactics: Oozes through hallways and drains. Cannot be reasoned with. Has no sense of fear.

name: Vat Horror
description: A lumpy, wet mass of failed corporate gene-splicing, growing every time someone feeds it.

powers.name: Toxic Spew
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Players damaged are poisoned (disadvantage) until they rest.

tactics: Escaped from a lab. Crashes through anything between it and food.

name: Gila Giant
description: A truck-sized, bead-skinned lizard that dozes in the sun and bites down like a vise.
tactics: Rarely attacks unless poked. Once it bites, it does not let go until killed or bribed.

name: Goat Sucker
description: A hunched, spiny, red-eyed thing that leaves drained cattle and a very uneasy ranch hand behind.
tactics: Attacks livestock at night. Runs from fire and from loud dogs.

name: Spiked Hodag
description: A grinning, spike-backed, toad-headed monster invented by a lumberjack and, regrettably, now real.
tactics: Hides in logging camps and steals pies. Runs from anything that asks too many questions.

name: Hive Lurker
description: A four-armed, claw-fingered predator that hides in vents and ceilings and moves like a nightmare.
tactics: Picks off sentries one at a time. Spreads infection to the survivors.

name: Rot Colossus
description: A bloated, fly-ridden giant of green flesh with a smile of broken teeth and a stomach full of plague.

powers.name: Rot Cloud
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Damaged players are poisoned until they rest.

tactics: Lumbers forward, infecting everything. Regenerates if not killed in one round.

name: Void Serpent
description: A kilometer-long, rock-colored worm that lives in asteroid fields and swallows small ships whole.
tactics: Hides inside asteroid caves. Retreats if it takes more than a few ships.

name: Sugar Wyrm
description: A glittering, gumdrop-scaled dragon with a licorice tail, spun-sugar wings and a lair of frosting.

powers.name: Frosting Blast
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Sticky icing that halves movement until it is cleaned off.

tactics: Offers cake and attacks only if refused. Weak to hot water and hungry players.

name: Vain Wyrm
description: A magnificent, jewel-encrusted dragon who admires his reflection and demands compliments before every fight.

powers.name: Vanity Breath
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Flames that sparkle and are very flattering.

tactics: Preens, boasts and demands tribute. Distracted by a mirror or a compliment.

name: Maggot Swarm
description: A pulsing, hissing heap of maggots and flies that crawls out of the wall when something dies.
tactics: Comes in a wave. Leaves everyone damaged with poison.

name: Mountain Griffin
description: A lion-bodied, eagle-headed, golden-winged creature that nests on cliff tops and hoards shiny things.
tactics: Dives from above. Calms if offered a fresh horse. Mounts for those who earn its trust.

name: Great Roc
description: A house-sized bird with a wingspan that blots out the sun and talons that carry off elephants.
tactics: Snatches a target and carries it off. Drops it from a height if it is hit.

name: Cave Wurm
description: A blind, pink, forty-foot earthworm with a mouthful of teeth that tunnels under the dungeon floor.

powers.name: Burrow
powers.text: No damage. Disappears underground and appears anywhere within 2 pencil lengths.

tactics: Bursts from the floor and disappears. Stops chasing if the players stand still.

name: Cloud Leviathan
description: A balloon-bellied, whale-shaped sky creature that floats through the clouds and swallows airships whole.
tactics: Floats near trade routes. Ignores people unless provoked.

name: Pipe Wyrm
description: A coiling, copper-piped dragon made of boilers, gears and a hot furnace for a heart.

powers.name: Scalding Breath
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Superheated steam.

tactics: Coils through the pipes and ducts of a factory. Weak to cold water.

name: Dust Titan
description: A hundred-foot, dust-colored giant that wakes in storms and walks through ruined cities like they're toys.

powers.name: Dust Storm
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Blinding sand and debris.

tactics: Walks in a straight line and ignores small targets. Only turns if hit by something big.

name: Shellback
description: A barnacle-crusted, rock-colored sea creature that looks exactly like a reef until it rolls over and snaps.
tactics: Waits at low tide in shallow water. Hides in its shell if it is hurt.

name: Stormbird
description: A ship-sized, grey-winged seabird that rides storm fronts and follows doomed ships for days.
tactics: Circles a ship until a storm rolls in. Attacks only at the worst moment.

name: Hull-Crusher
description: A cabin-sized, ten-armed sea monster that wraps a ship's hull and squeezes until it cracks.

powers.name: Ink Cloud
powers.text: No damage. Fills the water with a black cloud. All within sight have disadvantage to see or aim for a turn.

tactics: Strikes from below. Drags a ship's crew into the water one at a time.

name: Vending Machine Mimic
description: A street-corner snack dispenser with far too many teeth behind the coin slot.
tactics: Waits until someone feeds it coins, then swallows the whole arm. Spits out a single stale chip as an apology.

name: Tentacled Bellhop
description: A nervous bellhop in a tight uniform whose coat is hiding too many arms.

powers.name: Many Hands
powers.text: Attacks up to three enemies this turn with normal damage.

tactics: Carries bags, opens doors and holds six things at once. Gets very polite and then very violent if tipped badly.

name: Void Sultan
description: A masked ruler of a hundred worlds who bends starlight into a throne and does not rise from it.

powers.name: Starfall
powers.text: Area 2d6 damage to all enemies, ignores defense.

powers.name: Dark Grip
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target cannot move next turn.

tactics: Lets his guards fight first. Gets bored, stands and ends the fight in two moves.

name: Dune Gullet
description: A huge sandy pit lined with teeth and one very patient tentacle.

powers.name: Pit Pull
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is dragged to the pit and has disadvantage until it climbs out.

tactics: Lies buried in the dune and waits for a skiff to cross. Drags anything near the edge down the slope.

name: Slug Boss
description: A very large, very sticky crime lord who lounges on a throne of stolen cushions.
tactics: Lets bodyguards do the fighting and laughs at every injury. Offers bribes when the guards are gone.

name: Asteroid Leviathan
description: A mile-long worm that tunnels through asteroid fields and swallows small ships.

powers.name: Swallow Whole
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is swallowed and has disadvantage until freed.

tactics: Bursts out of an asteroid and swallows whatever is nearest. Spits it out in pieces if it chokes.

name: Sewer Vat Horror
description: A failed gene experiment that has outgrown its tank and is still growing.

powers.name: Spore Burst
powers.text: Area 2d6 damage to all enemies, ignores defense.

tactics: Reaches for anything warm. Splits into smaller pieces when hurt and crawls toward the nearest drain.

name: Boilerback Wyrm
description: A coal-black wyrm with boiler plates on its back that hisses steam when it is angry.

powers.name: Steam Vent
powers.text: Area 2d6 damage to all enemies, ignores defense.

tactics: Crashes through buildings to reach the smell of coal. Vents steam to scald anyone climbing it.

name: Highway Behemoth
description: A beetle the size of a freight truck with a cracked windshield stuck in its shell.

powers.name: Road Crush
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is pinned and has disadvantage until it breaks free.

tactics: Charges down a road and rolls over anything in its path. Sits down and chews on scrap if it has no target.

name: Wallpaper Thing
description: A patch of floral wallpaper that peels off the wall to wrap around anyone who leans on it.
tactics: Waits behind a nice painting. Wraps around the nearest guest and slides them into the wall.

name: Vent Crawler
description: A pale, many-legged thing that lives in the air ducts and drops on anyone who walks beneath.
tactics: Drops from a vent onto the last player in line.

name: Hangar Grub
description: A fat larva that burrows into cargo crates and gnaws through whatever is inside.
tactics: Bursts out of a crate. Swarms in threes if the GM wants a harder fight.

name: Alley Slime
description: A glowing puddle of runoff that has learned to climb walls and swallow shoes.
tactics: Waits in a puddle. Grabs a boot and slowly climbs.

name: Cactus Crawler
description: A walking barrel cactus with spines like fishhooks and a bad attitude.
tactics: Sits still among real cacti until someone gets close.

name: Barnacle Biter
description: A crab-shelled horror that clamps onto the hull and snaps at anyone who leans over the rail.
tactics: Clamps onto the ship. Grabs an ankle if a player leans over the side.

name: Boiler Newt
description: A salamander that lives in warm pipes and hisses scalding steam when it is cornered.
tactics: Hides in a pipe junction. Spits when someone opens the valve.

name: Mutant Grub
description: A bloated larva that feeds on tin cans and slowly glows brighter as it eats.
tactics: Mostly harmless alone. Draws more of its kind if it is hurt.

name: Canyon Wurm
description: A rock-colored worm as long as a train that bursts out of the canyon floor.

powers.name: Canyon Quake
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Knocks players prone.

tactics: Burrows under the biggest group. Surfaces when the ground stops shaking.

name: Tunnel Spawn
description: A toothy larval horror that crawls out of hull breaches in swarms.
tactics: Pours out of a vent in groups. Always one behind the one you killed.

name: Warp Behemoth
description: A twisted tower of flesh and warp-light that tears holes in reality when it moves.

powers.name: Reality Tear
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Spawns two Warp Imps in the zone.

tactics: Wades into the middle of the group. Rips a hole in the floor when badly hurt.

name: Biolab Escapee
description: A failed corp experiment, too many limbs on a body that was only meant to have two.
tactics: Staggers through the lab and thrashes at anything that moves.

name: Mesa Titan
description: A mountain-sized stone giant that wakes when the railroad drills into its back.

powers.name: Rockslide
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Rocks fall on everyone in the zone.

tactics: Rises slowly from the cliff face. Throws boulders if it cannot reach the group.

name: Drain Leech
description: A pale, rope-thick leech that lives in sewer tunnels and slides up through the drain.
tactics: Slides up from a drain and latches on. Hates salt.

name: Basement Elder
description: A many-eyed mass that waits under the floor of an old building and whispers names through the pipes.

powers.name: Unspeakable Gaze
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is stunned until they look away.

tactics: Does not move. Reaches up through the floor and pulls players down.

name: Sea Serpent
description: A hundred-foot serpent of black scales that rises from deep water to snap masts in half.

powers.name: Mast Snap
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target's ship loses its sails or steering.

tactics: Coils around the hull and squeezes. Dives when badly hurt.

name: Oil Slick Crawler
description: A pool of living oil that slides under doors and ignites at the worst moment.
tactics: Slides under the door and coats the floor. Catches fire if lit.

name: Furnace Maw
description: A fat, coal-eating worm that lives in factory furnaces and spits cinders at intruders.
tactics: Sits in the furnace door and spits. Dives in when hurt.

name: Sump Leech
description: A glowing, dog-sized leech that rises out of toxic ponds to attach itself to anything warm.
tactics: Slides out of the sludge and latches on. Salt makes it let go.

name: Glow Troll
description: A lumbering, radioactive brute that regrows its arms and carries a stop sign as a club.
tactics: Smashes whatever is closest. Grows back anything cut off by morning.

name: Asteroid Devourer
description: A stone-crunching worm the size of a cruiser that tunnels through asteroid belts.
tactics: Rams a hull from beneath. Retreats to an asteroid when hurt.

name: Plague Mammoth
description: A mutated mammoth with a cloud of buzzing flies and a back full of cysts.
tactics: Charges through ruins. Spews flies that sting.

name: Maelstrom Leviathan
description: An ocean-sized shape that rises inside whirlpools and swallows fleets.

powers.name: Maelstrom
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Drags every ship in the zone toward it.

powers.name: Deep Dive
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Drags the target underwater.

tactics: Pulls ships into a whirlpool. Surfaces to finish the survivors.

name: Nuclear Colossus
description: A cracked, glowing giant that sleeps under a ruined power plant and wakes when the rain gets heavy.

powers.name: Meltdown Pulse
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Gear in the zone is irradiated.

powers.name: Colossal Smash
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is knocked prone.

tactics: Rises slowly from the crater. Glows hotter when hurt.

name: Grot Gobbler
description: A fat, dopey xenos that swallows anything shiny and burps up grenades.
tactics: Waddles toward the nearest gadget. Spits it back out when startled.

name: Mutant Hedgehog
description: A hedgehog the size of a beachball that glows faintly and rolls downhill at anything it dislikes.
tactics: Rolls down hills and stairs. Curls up when frightened.

name: Nova Slug
description: A bloated slug that lives in nebula clouds and glows brighter when it eats power cells.
tactics: Sits across the corridor and secretes slime. Eats the power cell of any device nearby.

name: Bat-Swarm Colossus
description: A seething cloud of black bats that forms the shape of a hulking figure in the belfry.
tactics: Pours out of the belfry as a tide. Breaks apart if hit by light.

name: Sky-Pike Brood
description: A flock of armored sky-fish bred to pierce hulls, trailing a mother larger than a gunship.
tactics: Dives on the nearest hull. Retreats if the mother is hurt.

name: Smog Drake
description: A pollution-black drake that nests in the exhaust vents of mega-towers and wheezes toxic breath.

powers.name: Toxic Cloud
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Poisons everyone in the zone.

tactics: Hunts along the rooftops. Breathes a fog of smoke on a crowd.

name: Sandstorm Roc
description: An enormous bird of dust and feathers that rides desert storm-fronts.
tactics: Dives from the storm. Carries off a horse or a rider.

name: Catacomb Crawler
description: A pale, many-armed thing that lives in the cargo hold of an old wreck and grabs sailors from the dark.
tactics: Waits in the dark. Grabs the last sailor out of the hold.

name: Gutter Hag
description: A hunched creature that lives in the sewers of foundry cities and drags passersby into the drains.
tactics: Waits in a storm drain. Grabs a leg and pulls.

name: Vacuum Lurker
description: A pale, boneless thing that clings to the outside of space stations and slides in through the airlock seals.
tactics: Waits outside the airlock. Wraps a player and tries to pull them out into space.

name: Chrome Gargoyle
description: A winged guard-beast of polished chrome that perches on corporate towers and dives at intruders.
tactics: Perches on a ledge. Dives on whoever steps out of cover.

name: Rad-Moth Matriarch
description: A moth the size of a bus with wings that spray glowing dust, hovering above ruined cities.
tactics: Drifts above the ruins. Dusts the players with glowing spores.

name: Jolly Mimic Wagon
description: A cheerful traveling merchant cart with far too many teeth and a very good sale on right now.

powers.name: Grand Opening
powers.text: No damage. A player who touches its wares is stuck to it until they win a Physique test.

powers.name: Swallow Sale
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. A swallowed target is held inside until the wagon is hurt.

tactics: Lures players in with free samples. Lets go of anyone stuck to it once it is badly hurt.

name: Pillow Wyrm
description: An enormous, fluffy sleeping dragon whose snores are lullabies and whose dreams are weapons.

powers.name: Lullaby Snore
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Hit targets are sleepy (disadvantage) until they rest.

powers.name: Dream Spill
powers.text: No damage. Its dream becomes real in the room until it wakes.

tactics: Mostly wants to sleep. Hitting it makes it wake up cranky.

name: Canyon Wyrm
description: A mile-long sandworm that lives under the desert and swallows trains and towns whole.

powers.name: Swallow Whole
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Swallowed targets take damage each turn until freed.

powers.name: Quake
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Opens a pit under every target.

powers.name: Surface Strike
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense.

tactics: Attacks from below. Vibrations lure it; stay on rock.

name: Aether Kraken
description: A giant glowing squid-beast that swims through the aether and drags airships down to feed.

powers.name: Drag Down
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Grabs a target or small craft.

powers.name: Ink Storm
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Blinds the area.

powers.name: Tentacle Sweep
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense.

tactics: Wraps airships and drags them down. Lightning drives it off.

name: Gargoyle Informant
description: A winged stone watcher who knows everyone's secrets and sells them to the highest bidder.

powers.name: Stone Skin
powers.text: No damage. It ignores all damage for one turn.

powers.name: Dive Bomb
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense.

tactics: Plays both sides, then flies away when it loses. Pay it to switch.

name: Radiation Bloom
description: A giant glowing flower that spreads spores and warps everything it touches.

powers.name: Spore Cloud
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Hit targets are sick (disadvantage) until they rest.

powers.name: Photosynthesis
powers.text: Heals itself for 2d6 while standing in sunlight.

tactics: Rooted in place. Fire kills it, but also spreads the spores.

name: Elder Wyrm Sovereign
description: A dragon so old its scales are mountains and its hoard is a kingdom.

powers.name: World Fire
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Burns terrain.

powers.name: Crushing Tail
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense.

powers.name: Wing Storm
powers.text: No damage. Knocks everything prone and hides the sun.

powers.name: Hoard Heal
powers.text: Heals itself for 2d6 from its treasure.

tactics: Opens with World Fire, then lands to toy with the survivors. Offers a throne to anyone who kneels.

name: Mountain Eater
description: A walking apocalypse with a mouth like a canyon that eats mountains and rivers.

powers.name: Devour Land
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Swallows the target.

powers.name: Earthquake Stomp
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Splits the ground.

powers.name: Rampage
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense.

powers.name: Feast
powers.text: Heals itself for 2d6 by eating terrain.

tactics: Walks toward the nearest town. Cannot be stopped, only redirected.

name: Fallout Behemoth
description: A radiation-glowing titan born from the old world's worst mistake.

powers.name: Meltdown
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Poisons the area.

powers.name: Radiant Stomp
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense.

powers.name: Absorb Radiation
powers.text: Heals itself for 2d6 from nearby radiation.

tactics: Wanders toward the strongest radiation. Lead it into a clean zone.

name: Hive Queen
description: A giant insectoid queen that commands the swarm and lays more with every breath.

powers.name: Spawn Brood
powers.text: No damage. Adds a new swarm each turn.

powers.name: Acid Spray
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense.

tactics: Stays behind her swarm. Kill her and the swarm collapses.

name: Sphinx of the Ledger
description: A winged-lion sphinx with a human face and a ledger of every debt, sin and secret in the city.

powers.name: Pay Your Debt
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target loses something they owe.

powers.name: Riddle of Ruin
powers.text: No damage. A player must answer or lose a turn each round.

powers.name: Secret Ledger
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Reveals a secret.

tactics: Poses riddles and keeps score. Answer correctly to make it back down.

name: World Tree Guardian
description: A forest-sized, ancient tree with a face in its trunk and a root in every kingdom.

powers.name: Root Grab
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Holds targets until freed.

powers.name: Living Canopy
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Falling branches crush everything below.

powers.name: Photosynthesis
powers.text: Heals itself for 2d6 in sunlight.

powers.name: Seed Call
powers.text: No damage. Summons a new swarm of treants each turn.

tactics: Slow and patient. Fire hurts it, but angers the whole forest.

name: Cult Patriarch
description: The huge, purple, four-armed ancestor of a hidden cult whose children are everywhere.

powers.name: Hypnotic Gaze
powers.text: No damage. A target must obey one simple order unless they win a Wits test.

powers.name: Brood Call
powers.text: No damage. Adds a new group of hybrid cultists each turn.

tactics: Stays hidden in the nest and sends minions first. Kill the patriarch and the cult falls into chaos.
